about: Picture tests (tools/picture_check.js): each scene photographed by the live player at Phone quality, held still from its first moment, compared with its reference here; a film at its filmtime (seconds into its shots). mean: the most the pictures may differ on average (0..255 per channel); share: the most pixels that may differ by more than 24. A scene may carry its own mean or share, with why.

scenes.name: cabin
scenes.why: its fire flickers 30 times a second: the picture lands on one of two steps of it (mean 1.8 apart, 4.5% of pixels)
